article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 12 Master Broadcasts Dated Across The Navy Swings (Dave Brubeck), The Answer Man, Yankee Yarns, and Carson Robison
article-meta.kwd-group: The Navy Swings, Dave Brubeck Quartet, Bobby Troup, The Answer Man, Albert Mitchell, Carson Robison, Buckaroos, Yankee Yarns, Alton Hall Blackington, Johnny Mercer, Ben Selvin, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 85 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 85 recovers and dates 12 historical broadcasts spanning modern jazz recruitment radio, mid-century listener trivia phenomena, pioneering western cowboy transcriptions, New England coastal shipwrecks, and Roaring Twenties/Thirties dance bands: Dave Brubeck Quartet playing 'Watusi Drums' and Bobby Troup on ***The Navy Swings*** (1962), 2 wartime Q&A investigations by Albert Mitchell on ***The Answer Man*** (1944, tackling skywriting techniques and Hitler's personal phone exchange), 2 rare 1936 electrical transcription discs from Carson Robison and His Buckaroos on ***Carson Robison and His Buckaroos***, 2 authentic historical folklore narratives by Alton Hall Blackington on ***Yankee Yarns*** (1944, detailing the daring rescue of the schooner *Mertie B. Crowley* on Martha's Vineyard and Vermont hermits), Johnny Mercer swinging 'Running Wild' on ***Johnny Mercer's Music Shop*** (1944), and 3 pristine 1931 dance orchestra transcriptions from prolific bandleader Ben Selvin on ***Ben Selvin and His Orchestra***.
